title: fix(auth): say on /auth/config whether email leaves the deployment, so forgot-password can stop claiming a link was sent
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg6s33jXCmdvuMRxu2PeJhbi)_

domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbSX6BdpVNjS79LB5A

Fixes #30107

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `GET /api/v1/auth/config` gains an optional `features.emailDelivery` boolean (`AuthFeaturesConfigSchema` in `@objectstack/spec/api`), and the flag joins `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES`, so `requiresFeature` on an action accepts one more value, `'emailDelivery'`.
Metadata-protocol: added — that `requiresFeature` value is a new accepted value an author can write; the Claim's `none` was re-measured: the PR moves `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json` (a `none` declaration is refused for that by the level axis) and widens the `requiresFeature` enum.
Skills-docs: none — no skill or hand-written doc enumerates the `requiresFeature` values or the `/auth/config` feature flags; the generated reference pages (`content/docs/references/api/auth-endpoints.mdx`, `content/docs/references/ui/action.mdx`) carry the new member and value in this PR.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：登录配置接口 `GET /api/v1/auth/config` 新增一个开关 `features.emailDelivery`，说明「这台服务器能不能真的发出邮件」。只有接了邮件服务且该服务自报已配置时为 true；没有邮件服务、或用默认的 log 传输（只把邮件打印到服务器控制台）时为 false。忘记密码页据此就能不再谎称「重置链接已发送」。
- 为什么改：新装的自托管部署默认不发邮件，成员点忘记密码却看到「已将重置链接发送至你的邮箱」，等一封永远不会到的信；服务端其实知道发不出去，只写进日志，页面无从得知。
- 风险与回滚：只加一个可选字段，现有字段与行为不变。它说的是部署、不是某个邮箱：已注册和未注册的邮箱拿到的重置请求应答仍完全相同，不会泄露账号是否存在。判定复用邀请成员已在用的同一条规则（`isEmailDeliveryLive`），每次请求现读，邮件服务后配上也不用重启。回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts` 的 `getPublicConfig()` 里 `emailDelivery` 一行；`packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts` 的 `emailDelivery` 条目；`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/reset-request-mail-after-response.test.ts` 新增的一组用例。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/reset-request-mail-after-response.test.ts`，预期 1 个文件、12 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地；页面文案是 `domain:ui` 的另一半，由席位立卡。

## What changes

**The rule: the public auth config says whether mail leaves this deployment, and says it about the deployment, never about an address.**

- **The served flag (`@objectstack/plugin-auth`).** `getPublicConfig()` adds `features.emailDelivery: this.isEmailDeliveryLive()`. That is the one deliverability rule this package already has: the wired email service's own `isConfigured()`, read per call, the rule sign-up and invite-member's `outcome: 'sent' | 'link_only'` already use. It is not `hasEmailTransport()` / `isEmailServiceAvailable()`, which answer "a service object is wired" and are true on every default boot, whose `log` transport writes mail to the console. So: no email service, `false`; the `log` transport (or any service reporting itself unconfigured, or one without the member), `false`; a configured transport, `true`. Read at request time, so a transport configured later from the mail settings is reported without a restart. The hono adapter's `/auth/config` arm serves `getPublicConfig()` unchanged, so it serves the flag too.
- **The contract (`@objectstack/spec`).** `AuthFeaturesConfigSchema` gains `emailDelivery: z.boolean().optional()`, and `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES` classifies it (`surface: 'login'`, `semantics: 'opt-in'`, exempt: no spec input is gated), which the drift guard in plugin-auth requires for every boolean the config serves. Being classified also makes it a `requiresFeature` value, lowered to `features.emailDelivery == true`.
- **Why this carrier and not an `outcome` on the reset answer.** Measured both. The `/auth/config` flag has the exact precedent in `features.phoneNumberOtp` ("only advertised when an SMS service can actually deliver"), which already drives the phone branch of the same forgot-password form; the page reads the config before submit, so it can say "a reset link cannot be emailed here, ask an administrator" on the form itself instead of after a pointless submit; and the console's `forgotPassword(email)` resolves to `void` and discards the reset answer, so an answer member would need more console plumbing. The reset answer itself (`POST /api/v1/auth/request-password-reset`, `{ status: true, message }`) is not changed.
- **No account-existence oracle.** The flag is a property of the deployment and is the same for every caller. The reset request still answers a known and an unknown address with the same status and body, with and without mail; the new pins assert that in all three transport states.

## Tests

`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/reset-request-mail-after-response.test.ts`, a new top-level `describe` in the reset door's existing harness (real `AuthManager.handleRequest` over a real `ObjectQL` engine on better-sqlite3), 3 cases:

- no email service: `features.emailDelivery` is `false`, and the reset request for an address with an account and one without answers the same `200` body;
- a transport reporting itself unconfigured (the `log` shape): `false`, same answer for both addresses;
- a configured transport: `true`, both addresses answer the same, and that answer equals the one a deployment without mail gives.

Updated: the exact `features` fixture in `auth-manager.test.ts` (`emailDelivery: false`, no email service there), the served fixture in `packages/spec/src/api/auth-endpoints.test.ts`, and the registry roster in `packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.test.ts` (12 → 13 flags).

<details><summary>Ablations (forbidden behaviour put back with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, red seen, restored; the tests import `./auth-manager.js` from source)</summary>

- A. `emailDelivery: this.isEmailServiceAvailable()` (the "service wired" reader): `Tests 1 failed | 11 passed (12)` — the log-transport case, `AssertionError: expected true to be false`. Restore: blob `5bc1cba772b0…` equals the HEAD blob.
- B. the `emailDelivery` line deleted: `Tests 5 failed | 12 passed (17)` over the reset harness and `public-feature-registry.test.ts` — all three new cases, plus the registry drift guard ("every boolean flag served … is classified") and its default-semantics case. Restore: blob equals the HEAD blob.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The console half (`domain:ui`), not in this PR.** `ui/packages/auth/src/ForgotPasswordForm.tsx` and the `successDescription` strings in `ui/packages/i18n` still say the link was sent; the form should read `features.emailDelivery` from `/auth/config` (as it reads `phoneNumberOtp`) and, when it is not `true`, say a reset link cannot be emailed on this deployment and to ask an administrator (who can set a password from Setup → Users), the same for every address. Named for the seat to file; the UI lane is off duty.
- **Siblings measured.** The visitor verification-email resend already refuses with `400 EMAIL_SERVICE_REQUIRED` when the transport is not live (`visitor-verification-resend.ts`), so it does not say "sent". Invite-member already answers `outcome: 'link_only'`. `POST /magic-link/send` still answers success with no mail, but magic link is not advertised on `/auth/config` and no console UI calls it; a caller can now read `features.emailDelivery` first. Noted, not filed.
